name: ThreeUI Kage adapted as the Cosmic Scale editorial system

integration.fallback: The complete semantic DOM, navigation, editorial layout and local media remain available without WebGL.
integration.reducedMotion: Source-derived reduced-motion rules flatten reveals and nonessential motion.
modifications: Changed language, metadata, navigation and editorial copy to Polish space-science content.
Replaced Kage media frames with locally bundled, credited NASA media.
Removed all source foreground PNG cut-outs and disabled the original temple renderer.
Retained the Kage typography, spacing, cards, chapter navigation, responsive rules and interaction grammar.
Adapted source navigation, reveal, cursor, grain and hero-exit wiring into a local integration bundle.

visualDepth.scrollMapping: Source-derived chapter navigation and reveal mapping documented in page-wiring.js.
visualDepth.pointerMapping: Source-derived cursor interaction plus the separately sourced Galaxy pointer field.
visualDepth.reducedMotion: Reveals become immediate and the WebGL time/pointer response is disabled.
visualDepth.mobileFallback: Source-defined responsive layout and a local NASA image behind the optional WebGL layer.
